dedupe_keys.name: modelling of photovoltaic plants with communication delays based on field measurements

description: The source identifies discrete- and continuous-time plant models from measured input/output behaviour of an operating medium-scale photovoltaic installation connected to the Spanish distribution grid. Models represent central-controller communication and computation delays for power-setpoint behaviour at 0.1–1.5 Hz, and are checked with time-domain simulation and Bode plots. This deposit documents identified plant dynamics; underlying field measurements are not assumed publicly released. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: Modelling of Photovoltaic Plants with Communication Delays based on Field Measurements
